<!-- Generated by tools/docs/generate.py from the admin application's routes and auth_middleware.required_roles(). Do not edit by hand. -->

The console and its JSON API share one server. Every route except the public ones needs a signed-in admin session; `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header from `GET /auth/csrf`. The machine-readable description is [openapi.json](/admin-api/openapi.json).
